Ivy (Support): Escalation T-15021: trial account LunarMetrics seeing embed 504s after SSO roll. Their QA run is blocked, renewal in 11 days.
Ben (CS): Please paste a 1-2 line impact summary, what's been attempted, and the customer contact. We need a short customer-facing note and an internal comms list.
Ivy (Support): Impact: embed success dropped from ~98% to ~28% in last 70m. Logs: 'POST /v1/embeds -> 504 gateway timeout -> kvcache miss cascade'. Tried: restarted pool, bumped timeouts, no effect. Contact: Zoe Park (zoe@lunarmetrics.io), PST.
Kai (Solutions): Short-term mitigation: route tenant to a brief dedicated burst slice and pin to stable embed variant (rwd-embed-stable-3b). Also enable tenant prefix caching TTL=3600. I can stage routing change once Ops confirms pool.
Ruth (Ops): I can provision a 2h burst (1xA10G) if AE approves reserved units. Will post smoke test command and results. notify-bot: created incident bridge https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-15021 auto.
Ben (CS): Ivy, draft the customer message (2 sentences + ETA) here; include whether to offer trial credit. I'll send once Ops confirms.
Ivy (Support): Draft: "Hi Zoe - were seeing intermittent timeouts from our embeddings API after your SSO update. We're applying a mitigation (route to a dedicated slice) within the next 90 minutes and will update by 14:00 PST. Apologies for the interruption; we'll follow up with an RCA."
Ben (CS): Tweak: add cc cs@redwood.com and offer a 10% trial credit for impacted validation runs. Scheduling 14:00 PST bridge. Internal comms checklist: 1) notify AE + renewal owner, 2) ops mitigation window 2h, 3) offer 10% credit, 4) open RCA and assign Eng owner within 48h. Marking Priority: High.
Ruth (Ops): Provisioned burst-lunar-1. Smoke: 20/20 success, median latency 170ms. Run this from support console to validate once I say go:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"smoke"}' | jq '.status'
```
Ivy (Support): Verified 100% success on repeated calls. Sending Ben the draft. Captured request IDs for RCA.
Ben (CS): Outreach sent to Zoe (cc cs@redwood.com). After the bridge paste verbatim customer feedback here for renewal risk assessment. Thanks team :heart:
